title: UK Regulatory Monitor
subtitle: FCA · PRA · ICO · CMA · FRC — enforcement, guidance, and rulemaking
schedule_note: Updated every 6 hours via GitHub Actions

items.title: Joint taskforce continues crack down on misleading car finance claims adverts
items.summary: The FCA, Advertising Standards Authority, Solicitors Regulation Authority and Information Commissioner's Office are tackling the poor handling of motor finance claims by some claims companies and law firms.

items.title: UK financial regulators to begin overseeing Critical Third Parties announced by Treasury
items.summary: The Bank of England (the Bank), the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and the FCA will start overseeing the first critical third parties (CTPs) on Monday 13 July 2026, following designation by the Treasury.

items.title: FCA cracks down on illegal promotions and market abuse in first year of new strategy
items.summary: The FCA led an international crackdown on illegal finfluencer promotions – resulting in 3 arrests and 650 social media takedown requests.

items.title: PRA fines HDI Global SE £4,165,000 for inaccurate reporting of FSCS Liabilities and FSCS Fee Tariff data
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has imposed a financial penalty of £4,165,000 on HDI Global SE in connection with the submission of incorrect data to the PRA.

items.title: UK financial regulators to begin overseeing Critical Third Parties announced by HM Treasury
items.summary: The Bank of England, the Prudential Regulation Authority and the Financial Conduct Authority will start overseeing the first Critical Third Parties on Monday 13 July 2026, following designation by HM Treasury.

items.title: Managing conflicts of interest in insurance
items.summary: Having just joined as the FCA’s new insurance director, it’s been great getting to know the team and see the variety of work they’re doing – whether that’s working with the industry to improve claims experiences for customers, consulting on simplifyi

items.title: Streamlined rulebook to save asset managers £128m a year
items.summary: The FCA has proposed a package of reforms that would tailor requirements proportionately for asset managers, cut costs for firms and give better data to supervise the sector more effectively.

items.title: FCA publishes landmark review into impact of AI on retail financial services
items.summary: The review sets out how AI could reshape retail financial services for consumers, firms, markets and regulators by 2030 and beyond.

items.title: The Bank, FCA and HM Treasury joint statement on Frontier AI models and cyber resilience
items.summary: Statement from the Bank of England, Financial Conduct Authority and HM Treasury

items.title: PRA sets out adjustments to its market risk internal model approach under Basel 3.1
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has today published a consultation on the internal model approach to market risk (IMA), which represents the final piece of Basel 3.1’s implementation in the UK.

items.title: Pension firms must do more for customers in older pensions and fund savings
items.summary: The FCA has found that peopleholding legacy pension products,now closed to newsavers, could be receiving poorer value than those in newer ones.

items.title: New member appointed to the Regulatory Decisions Committee
items.summary:
The FCA Board has appointed Dan Lavender as a new member of its Regulatory Decisions Committee (RDC).

The RDC is responsible for taking certain regulatory decisions on behalf of the FCA relating to contested enforcement action.

items.title: FCA and Bank of England set out shared vision for tokenisation in UK wholesale markets
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of England set out a shared vision and seek industry views on the future of UK wholesale markets

items.title: PRA announces ring-fence change to reduce costs
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority has today announced plans to consult on reforming rules around shared operational services for ring-fenced banks.

items.title: PRA publishes plans to support resilience in the life insurance industry
items.summary: Funded reinsurance transactions involving UK life insurers will face enhanced regulatory requirements under new proposals unveiled today by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA).

items.title: CMA letter to PHIN welcoming achievement of gold compliance milestone
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) welcomes the achievement by the Private Healthcare Information Network (PHIN) and the private healthcare industry of the ‘gold milestone’ of full compliance with the CMA’s Private …

items.title: Court endorses CMA action as Emma Sleep agrees to change sales practices
items.summary: The CMA has secured a court-endorsed settlement from mattress firm Emma Sleep after concerns its sales practices misled consumers.

items.title: Why getting product design right really matters to consumers
items.summary: Financial products and services shape some of the most important decisions we all make – from saving and borrowing, to protecting ourselves and our families when things go wrong.

items.title: CMA orders StubHub UK to refund customers over hidden fees
items.summary: StubHub UK must refund more than 50,000 customers and pay a fine close to £900,000.

items.title: CMA orders Marks Electrical to refund customers over pre-selected extra charges
items.summary: Marks Electrical must refund nearly 40,000 customers and pay a fine after it automatically opted customers into additional paid services.

items.title: Bank of England launches policy statement and draft rules on regulating systemic stablecoins
items.summary: The Bank of England has today published its policy statement and draft Code of Practice (rules) for systemic stablecoin issuers.

items.title: Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority – Memorandum of Understanding on the supervision of Financial Market Infrastructure
items.summary: Joint statement from the Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority

items.title: Open letter to the private parking sector
items.summary: A letter issued by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) to private parking operators.

items.title: CMA letter to government in relation to private parking
items.summary: Letter sent by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) to the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.

items.title: CMA correspondence in relation to early years education and childcare sector
items.summary: Letters between the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) and minsters in UK government.

items.title: Banks told to improve access to basic accounts
items.summary: People struggling should find it easier to access basic bank accounts, after nine banks committed to improving widespread poor practice identified by the FCA.

items.title: PRA and FCA propose new captive insurance regime to drive UK growth and competitiveness
items.summary: Innovative new proposals aim to establish the UK as a centre for the fast-growing captive insurance market.

items.title: FCA and PRA confirm changes to streamline senior manager accountability and boost growth
items.summary: The PRA and FCA have set out reforms to the Senior Managers and Certification Regime, designed to reduce costs and offer greater flexibility.

items.title: Purpose and pragmatism in the UK’s digital markets competition regime
items.summary: A speech by Will Hayter, the CMA’s Executive Director for Digital Markets, delivered at CompLaw: Digital Conference.

items.title: Tribunal was “wrong” to reject CMA phenytoin decision, says Court
items.summary: The Court of Appeal has ruled the Tribunal was “wrong to set aside the [CMA’s] decision” in relation to its investigation into phenytoin – a life-saving epilepsy drug.
